name: OpenGameArt (per-asset licences)
licence_summary: Each OpenGameArt submission has its own licence (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, OGA-BY, GPL ...). You may use art commercially if you follow its licence. Credit in the artist's 'Copyright/Attribution Notice' format when one is given.
cautions: CC-BY 3.0 and CC-BY-SA forbid adding technical restrictions (DRM); OGA-BY exists to allow DRM platforms.
Collections mix licences; credit every contributing author.
Mirrors can disagree with the original (Pixel Adventure is CC0 on itch.io, CC-BY 4.0 on OGA).
